translations.web: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
translations.bsb: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority. My people love it so, but what will you do in the end?
translations.kjv: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end
